hypothesis: Excluding the blank class from positive-path teacher-margin competition preserves token identity without B14's incentive to raise nonblank against blank; same coefficient 0.08, no score-tuned coefficient sweep.
prerequisite: Use only frozen 79 authenticated synthetic TRAIN originals, nine owner-reviewed natural TRAIN negatives and 120 source-verified teacher-positive original/gain pairs. The 24 new natural TRAIN originals remain ineligible until human-reviewed; B14 DEV and B14 sealed replication are forbidden.

natural.selection: Predeclare prospective salt-sorted speaker-and-utterance picks from authenticated official source before scoring; no DEV read or outcome-based replacement in training

replication.opening: Only if independently frozen B15 primary passes without changes to parameters, decoder, source roster or selection rule

primary_gate.positive: B15 retains every complete hit from frozen B0 and matched control on the same admitted positive original and gain; never produces extra duplicate wake events relative to B9 or control
primary_gate.ordinary: No added events versus matched control or B9 on any admitted ordinary original/gain; natural event totals at every gain no higher than B0
primary_gate.generalization: At original gain improve ordinary false events against B9 in at least two distinct readers, restore at least one qualified positive family missed by control
primary_gate.reject_if: Any positive-loss, added ordinary events, failure of natural B0 parity, missing source evidence, source leakage, or incomplete five-observer coverage
primary_gate.promote_only_after: New model true PT/ONNX/C11/Cortex-A32 parity; independent untouched replication PASS; physical SSC305/AFE/callback metrics and fresh field recordings

false_alarm_reporting: Only continuous real background exposure can support FAR/hour and confidence bounds. Isolated short clips are diagnostic counts, never FAR/h.
